definitions.json_invalid_rate: strict JSON action parsing/schema errors divided by all model decisions; retrieval execution failures are counted separately
definitions.premature_stop: explicit final_answer with incomplete gold sentence evidence, divided by all episodes
definitions.recovery: a subsequent successful retrieval yields a previously unseen sentence ID; also report endpoint JointSuccess
definitions.retrieval_calls: retrieve_docs action attempts, including duplicates, matching historical MeanToolCalls
definitions.zero_exposures: null rate; absence of an opportunity is not evidence of recovery
